messages:
marta_cs: Asteria Diagnostics requests onboarding of a multilingual 7B clinical summarizer for discharge + consult notes. Requirements: PHI redaction with auditable events, HSM/KMS key-wrapping, int8 quant profile, p95 <=120ms, steady 30 qps with 120 qps burst. Renewal in 5 days — this could impact renewal if delayed.
jen_pm: Thanks. @marta_cs can you get their prompt bank, a labeled eval set (PHI tags per-record), and a SOC2 snapshot? Also confirm Private vs Dedicated. HSM will push towards Private.
alonzo_se: For safety eval I'll run: (1) redaction recall/precision across entity types, (2) hallucination spot checks on clinical Q&A, (3) language parity tests across en/es/pt. Need model artifact or recipe and quantization target (int8 ok).
priya_infra: Early infra note: 7B int8 + KV cache looks like 2xA10G for steady 30 qps, autoscale policy for bursts; HSM provisioning ~5 biz days. I'll validate memory & concurrency numbers and post a cost delta.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: DR-9982. Security scans queued. https://deploys.internal/DR-9982
marta_cs: I'll request eval set + prompts + any preferred SLA wording today. Also asking customer if they need canary traffic split and rollback window.
jen_pm: Let's make renewal trigger: onboarding incomplete by renewal date OR post-enablement CSAT <4 => escalate to AM and open renewal mitigation plan. Add to account health.
alonzo_se: I'll prepare a small harness for redaction tests and share a minimal runner for preprod: ```python
for e in eval_examples:
    r = client.generate(model="asteria-7b-v1", prompt=e)
    assert not leaked_phi(r)
```
priya_infra: Posting sizing + provisioning ETA by EOD tomorrow.
marta_cs: Actions: 1) eval set + prompts + SOC2 (marta_cs) 2) safety harness & test plan (alonzo_se) 3) infra sizing & HSM timeline (priya_infra) 4) schedule enablement & own renewal mitigation (jen_pm). I'll mark account health as "at risk" until onboarding completes. :warning:
